dialogue: You are finally awake!

choices.description: Who are you?
What is going on?
Where am I?

dialogue: Oh, you probably have so many questions. But trust me, the only thing important here is what you decide to do and the choices you are going to make.

choices.description: nxt

dialogue: I can't tell you much right now. All I can say is that you have a very special purpose in this world. It is up to you to find out what that is and what you choose to do with that information.

choices.description: nxt

dialogue: I am going to put you through a simulation of what you could possibly live your life like. Your goal is to simply find out what is the meaning of this concept called: faith.

choices.description: nxt

dialogue: Faith is a very interesting concept. And you might find yourself facing challenges about that. But don't worry, remember that this is all just a simulation and what's important is the destination at the end.

choices.description: nxt

dialogue: Well that's it for me. I am going to send you in now. Always remember that when you make a choice, make one that you won't regret. Are you ready?

choices.description: Yes, but I have a something to ask
Wait, I still don't know who you are!
I still don't understand what is going on.

dialogue: Don't worry, everything will make sense in the end. See you on the other side!

choices.description: nxt

dialogue: In the blink of an eye, you suddenly wake up in the middle of nowhere. You look around at the scenery on what appears to be a farm.

choices.description: Where am I?
Woah, I love farms!

dialogue: Why hello there stranger!

choices.description: nxt

speaker: Clair
dialogue: I wasn't expecting visitors today. My name is Clair, and I'm the owner of this farm. Say, what is your name?

choices.description: Text

speaker: Clair
dialogue: Nice to meet you {player.name}! What brings you here to my lovely farm?

choices.description: I was just passing by and found this place.
I might have been sent here on a mission of understanding faith.
I'm not sure either. I just kind of woke up in this place.

speaker: Clair
dialogue: Oh that's great. Since you have nothing better to do, let me show you around!

choices.description: nxt

speaker: Clair
dialogue: Wow, that sounds very interesting. In that case, let me show you around the place if you don't mind.

choices.description: nxt

speaker: Clair
dialogue: So this place over here is my farm. I mostly work here with my friend Elaina. We provide fresh produce for the town with the crops we grow here. We mostly work during the whole week except for Sundays, which we spend the time going to the church.

choices.description: next

speaker: Clair
dialogue: We also live in the house over there in the distance near our farm. It's a very cozy life even though the work can become a lot. Say that reminds me, you should come to the festival tonight in town!

choices.description: A festival? That sounds fun!
I don't know, I still don't know anyone around here..

speaker: Clair
dialogue: I hope to see you there. There are also lots of cool people to meet there, so I hope you enjoy it!

choices.description: I can't wait!
I hope to meet new people!

speaker: Clair
dialogue: That's alright. Since you are new here, I think you should take the opportunity to make new friends before the festival.

choices.description: Sounds like a plan!
I'm still a little skeptical but sure thing.

speaker: Clair
dialogue: Great! Now I guess that wraps up our tour. Do you have any questions?

choices.description: I actually have a question about faith?
Do you know what religion is?
I want to understand more about religion and faith

speaker: Clair
dialogue: Interesting question.

choices.description: nxt

speaker: Clair
dialogue: To me faith and religion are two different concepts that intertwine with each other. Religion is basically what we believe in that is engraved in our culture. Its normally rooted in tradition and belief in God or some other deity

choices.description: nxt

speaker: Clair
dialogue: Faith on the other hand, I guess that's just the way we put our trust into others. But it's not the kind of trust you have fully built up, sometimes it involves following a hunch. Just like how I put my faith that you would be a nice neighbor even though I have never met you.

choices.description: nxt

speaker: Clair
dialogue: Everyone has their own set of beliefs, and within that they also have their own levels of faith. Personally, I'm a believer in God and that He created all of us with a divine purpose in mind. Does that make sense?

choices.description: I think I get what you mean
I'm still a little skeptical. But I see what you mean
I was sent here by a mysterious being, could that have been God?

speaker: Clair
dialogue: That's good to hear. You know, you should pass by the church if you are curious. Maybe Father Lorens can help you out.

choices.description: nxt

speaker: Clair
dialogue: That's fair. There's nothing wrong with being skeptical, in fact, it might help you build your faith! You know, you should consider visiting the church if you want to learn more. Maybe Father Lorens can explain it better than me.

choices.description: Sure thing, I'd love to understand my religion better.
I'll think about it. I might want to explore first.

speaker: Clair
dialogue: A mysterious being? Maybe God sent you here so I could be your friend! Haha. Kidding. But if you really want to know, you should visit Father Lorens at the church. Maybe he can help you.

choices.description: I'll check it out, I really want to understand my purpose.
Thanks for the output, I will consider it!

speaker: Clair
dialogue: Anyway, I still got work to do around the farm before the festival tonight. I hope to see you there! Nice meeting you {player.name}

choices.description: See you there!
Thank you!

dialogue: You leave the farm and head off towards the direction of the town. You learned a little more about your purpose, but you still have lots of questions. Such as, was the mysterious deity who sent you here God? Do we really have to fulfill what He said? And if not, what is our purpose then?

choices.description: nxt

dialogue: You arrive at a fork in the road that leads in two different directions. One leads to the church that Clair was talking about, and the other to the park. If we visit the church, we might have the opportunity to learn more about what faith is. If we visit the park, we might be able to fulfill a bigger purpose.

choices.description: Let's head to the church so we can investigate further on the meaning of faith
Let's head to the park and hopefully we can understand what faith is another way

dialogue: After a few minutes of walking, you arrive at the church. The place looks very old yet grand. It also feels peaceful here.

choices.description: nxt

dialogue: Greetings friend. I heard there was a new neighbor in town.

choices.description: nxt

speaker: Father Lorens
dialogue: My name is Father Lorens and this is Brother Byron. What is your name?

choices.description: nxt

speaker: Brother Byron
dialogue: Hello {player.name}, it is very nice to meet you. What brings you here to the church? Is there anything we can help you with?

choices.description: I was hoping to learn more about religion
I want to learn more about the meaning of faith
I think God sent me on a mission on this world

speaker: Father Lorens
dialogue: Well, you have come to the right place! What specifically about faith and religion do you wish to understand?

choices.description: I want to know more about the meaning of faith
I want to learn more about your religion and God
I'm having some doubts about my own faith

speaker: Father Lorens
dialogue: A mission? Well, what did God ask you to do?

choices.description: I was tasked with discovering the meaning of faith
Honestly, I'm not sure. It has something to do with understanding faith

speaker: Father Lorens
dialogue: Oh, I see. That is a question every believer asks themselves once in a while. Belief in God is very interesting, because truly, there isn't any way to truly verify if God exists. Instead, we look at the many ways that God reveals Himself to us, like through His creation and through His miracles.

choices.description: nxt

speaker: Brother Byron
dialogue: It is natural to doubt your current understanding of God, because truth is, that doubt is what allows us to seek room to further grow our connection with God. Everything in this world is born out of reason and the need to understand everything, faith is what softens it and instead reminds us that not everything can be understood and sometimes we just need to be guided through that darkness.

choices.description: nxt

dialogue: You explain to Brother Byron and Father Lorens about how you believe God sent you to this world and the mission He gave you

choices.description: Was it really God that sent me to this mission?
I still feel very lost
I think I better understand now and trust in God's plans for me all the way

speaker: Father Lorens
dialogue: To be honest, who really knows? But isn't that what faith already is? It's ironic, you were sent out on a mission to understand faith and you end up exercising it in the first place. Maybe this is mission-complete for you? But I can tell by your face that you still have some doubt that is clearly directed at the identity of God.

choices.description: nxt

speaker: Father Lorens
dialogue: I think maybe the problem is that you see religion and faith as the same. In fact, let's forget that there is a connection between them. You still went out to do what you were told to do, that is faith. You were given a purpose and you believed in it. The thing you are questioning is the existence of God, and the culture of belief around him, that culture is religion. It is our belief in the Word of God that forms religion, don't you see? Faith is our inner choice to connect with God, Religion is just our way of doing it.

choices.description: nxt

speaker: Father Lorens
dialogue: So you are already full of faith in God, because you chose to come here and ask about Him. Even if you still have doubts about the religion, I believe that you already understand your own purpose. Religion is just your decision to devote yourself to God's existence, but actually following what you believe God is telling you to do in your heart and not just your mind, that is faith.

choices.description: Wow, that was very insightful. Thank you.
So I should just dedicate my entire faith into entrusting myself unto God?
But if God doesn't really exist, would it really matter?

speaker: Brother Byron
dialogue: Not completely. Faith is not just about pure trust in God, it's also about choosing to act out it and what you believe. And another important aspect is your worship and belief in God. While your belief does appear to be your weaker spot, you are still in the process of exploring your own faith and that is fine.

choices.description: I think I better understand it now. Faith isn't just about blind trust.
But what if God wasn't the one who sent me, what would it mean for me?

speaker: Brother Byron
dialogue: Well, maybe the question you should be asking yourself is if you do what you do because you believed God was real, because it felt right, or because you knew deep down it had to be something special?

choices.description: I heard about God, so I believe that He had to be real and was the one who did this for me
It had to be something special. I just put my faith in the one who sent me.
It just felt like the right thing to do deep down. I never expected it to be this meaningful.

speaker: Father Lorens
dialogue: I'm glad to hear that. But, I think we both know your journey doesn't end here yet. There are many more ways that you can exercise your faith through doing what is right, and further refining your belief in God. But that decision is up to you.

choices.description: I wish to further express my faith in what I do.
I wish to further express my faith by understanding more about God
I think I still need more info before I come into a conclusion

speaker: Father Lorens
dialogue: Good to know you have made up your mind. Unfortunately, Brother Byron and I have something important to attend to, but you are still welcome to stay around if you want. It was nice meeting you {player.name}, I hope to see you at the festival tonight.

dialogue: See you! It was nice meeting you.
